XYZ Corporation shows mixed financial health. While revenue grew by 20% (from $500 million to $600 million), operating costs also increased significantly (from $300 million to $400 million), keeping the operating margin stable at approximately 33%. This indicates that cost management did not improve alongside revenue growth. More concerning is the rise in the debt-to-equity ratio from 0.5 to 0.8, signaling increased financial leverage and higher risk. The company is growing but becoming more indebted, which could pose challenges if interest rates rise or earnings fluctuate.

The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.
